title: Allow OS-authorized administrative operations for the owner-managed Linux agent.
changes: Stop installing NoNewPrivileges=true in the per-user Linux systemd service, and migrate legacy agent units during the normal CLI update lifecycle.

Report the actual Linux process NoNewPrivs status and effective UID, distinguish macOS authorization and privacy permissions, and inspect Windows token integrity rather than assuming a scheduled task is elevated.
Add regression coverage for legacy systemd migration, Windows medium/high-integrity tokens and transient named-pipe fixture cleanup on Windows.
God Mode does not grant root or bypass operating-system permissions. Existing Linux service processes require a controlled restart before the changed systemd policy takes effect.
